pin.pinException: The microsoft/azure-skills tools target the 3.0 contract (removed parameters are rejected), and 3.0 marks the MySQL and PostgreSQL query tools destructive, so --read-only hides them. Re-pin to a 3.0.x at least 7 days old when there is one (2026-10-19 or later).

azure.why: Read-only Azure tools through az login; each pack picks its namespaces (no Key Vault). App Service settings, which can hold connection strings, are returned only after a consent prompt. The foundry and arm namespaces proxy Microsoft's hosted servers, so which of their tools count as read-only comes from those services at run time, and foundryextensions can call deployed models, which spends tokens. The first start downloads about 62 MB.

docs-langchain.why: Searches the LangChain, LangGraph and Deep Agents docs, current to the release, instead of what a model remembers.

fastmcp-docs.why: Searches the FastMCP docs (two read-only tools); its feedback tool is denied.

gradio-docs.why: Searches and loads the Gradio docs for the gradio pack.

huggingface.why: Finds and inspects models, datasets and Spaces on the Hub, anonymously (read-only).

microsoft-learn.why: Microsoft and Azure documentation for Codex; Claude Code has it from the microsoft-docs plugin.

playwright.why: Drives a real browser. Pinned, with a fresh profile each session (--isolated), headless, and snapshots written outside the repository; replaces the playwright plugin, which runs @latest with a persistent profile.

reference-langchain.why: Looks up LangChain API symbols and their signatures.

shadcn.why: Searches and views items in the project's shadcn registries, and gives the command that adds one (it installs nothing itself).
